status: DIAGNOSTIC. Not pre-registered, no bar, licenses nothing, adopts nothing. Recorded output of the one run of id_quality.py, 2026-08-02.
question: The id path removes name matching but substitutes MusicBrainz's link accuracy. How good are those links on the artists the app actually delivers?
why_the_result_is_transcribed_rather_tha: id_quality.py printed its result and did not serialise it. The figures are cited in NEXT.md and in PR #65, so they needed a committed home; this file is that home. Re-running is possible but not free: it needs a post-drop verification build (graph-deezerid-verify.bin, gitignored and since deleted, ~7 min to rebuild) and 120 live Deezer calls. The sample seed is fixed (20260802), so a rerun draws the SAME 60 artists.
population: interior artists delivered by routing the 120 committed TAS- pairs with production weights, restricted to those carrying a Deezer id

thin_pages_among_the_live.reading: MOST of these are genuinely obscure artists, for whom a low follower count is expected and says nothing about link quality. The signal does NOT separate 'duplicate page' from 'small artist' on its own -- it needs follower count read against how famous we independently believe the artist to be.

observed.name: Orbital
observed.verdict: DUPLICATE. Orbital is a well-known electronic act; a page with 20 followers is not the real one, and it DOES serve tracks, so here the id path replaces a correct name-search result with a worse one.

hand_checked_separately.name: Radiohead
hand_checked_separately.verdict: DUPLICATE, but FAILS SAFE -- zero albums means no top track, so the resolver falls back to name search.

conclusion: The net is clearly positive against the 9.4% / 6.1% wrong-artist rate the id path removes, but it is NOT 'strictly better by construction' -- a claim made on 2026-08-02 before this was measured and withdrawn on the strength of it. The direction of any individual case is not guaranteed.
targeted_mitigation_if_ever_wanted: Validate links for the top popularity decile only (~7,400 lookups), where a duplicate is both most detectable (expected follower count is high) and most damaging (those artists are delivered most often). Not done; recorded as a deferral in NEXT.md.
